question: The Rourkela Steel plant was set up in the year _______ in Odisha state.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1959**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rourkela Steel Plant** was set up in the year **1959** in Odisha state.
 
• It was the first integrated steel plant in the public sector in India.
 
• The plant was built with assistance from the German firms Krupp and Demag.
 
• **Rourkela Steel Plant** is a unit of the **Steel Authority of India Limited** (SAIL).
 
• It is known for producing various steel products and has contributed significantly to the industrial development of the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odisha** is rich in minerals and has a significant role in India's steel production.
 
• The establishment of the Rourkela Steel Plant marked the beginning of the industrialization era in Odisha.
 
• Over the years, the plant has undergone several modernization and expansion programs to enhance its production capacity and efficiency.
 
• Rourkela city has developed around the steel plant and is known for its planned layout and infrastructure.
